title: R Madhavan took a piece of Hawa Mahal to Padma Shri ceremony- All about the unique ₹40 lakh Titan watch
summary: R Madhavan's Padma Shri appearance turned heads for more than the honour. The actor wore a rare ₹40 lakh Titan Nebula Flying Tourbillon, with only 10 pieces made worldwide.
